typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		GRGR_ID as string,
		GRGR_EFF_DATE as timestamp,
		GRGR_TERM_DATE as timestamp,
		CSCS_ID as string,
		CSCS_EFF_DATE as timestamp,
		CSCS_TERM_DATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SET NOCOUNT ON EXEC WriteOff.Pr_FetchBrandingData',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of GRGR_ID} = GRGR_ID,
		{Copy of CSCS_ID} = toString(CSCS_ID)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of GRGR_ID} as string,
		{Copy of CSCS_ID} as string,
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		{Copy of GRGR_ID},
		{Copy of CSCS_ID},
		{})) ~> OutputPlaceHolderOracleDestination
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
